name: City of Dreams
source:
Follow the adventures of a small-town girl in the big city as she pursues her dream of becoming an actress.

Claire has always dreamed of becoming an actress and to escape from her boring life in a small town. She loves to perform, to make people laugh but so far she lacked the opportunities and the confidence to pursue her passion.

That's why she decides to move to the big city, where she hopes to find fame, fortune and opportunity. But the city is not as glamorous as she imagined. 

She will face rejection, competition, and deception. She will have to struggle to balance her personal and professional life as well as her finances. She will meet new friends and enemies, allies and rivals, lovers and haters. And she discovers that acting is not only a dream, but also a challenge.

Will Claire achieve her goal of becoming an actress? Will she find happiness and love in the city? Will she overcome the obstacles and the surprises that await her?  Or will she go down an altogether different path and lose herself in the promises of the big city.

Follow Claire's exciting, heartwarming and spicy adventures in the big city as she pursues her dream of becoming an actress.

[From [url=https://vncityofdreams.itch.io/city-of-dreams]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟随一个小镇女孩在大城市追求成为演员的梦想的冒险经历。

克莱尔一直梦想成为一名演员，并逃离小镇上无聊的生活。她喜欢表演，喜欢让人们开怀大笑，但到目前为止，她缺乏机会和信心去追求自己的激情。

这就是为什么她决定搬到大城市，她希望在那里找到名誉、财富和机会。但这座城市并没有她想象的那么光鲜亮丽。

她将面临拒绝、竞争和欺骗。她将不得不努力平衡她的个人和职业生活以及她的财务状况。她将遇到新的朋友和敌人、盟友和对手、爱人和仇恨者。而她发现演戏不仅是一个梦想，更是一个挑战。

克莱尔能否实现成为演员的目标呢？她能在这座城市找到幸福和爱情吗？她能克服等待她的障碍和惊喜吗？或者她会走上一条完全不同的道路，迷失在大城市的承诺中。

跟随克莱尔在大城市中经历的激动人心、温馨而辛辣的冒险，追寻她成为演员的梦想。

[来自[url=https://vncityofdreams.itch.io/city-of-dreams]Itch.io[/url]]
